description.subtitle: Adidas water bottle of the Real Madrid 600 ml - white
description.intro: The 600 ml adidas Real Madrid bottle is designed for fans who want to take the passion for the white club anywhere. Inspired by the club’s historical identity and iconic equipment, it combines an elegant design with resistant materials to accompany you in workouts, matches or day to day.
key_benefits: Capacidad de 600 ml: Ideal para entrenamientos y uso diario.
Material resistente: Fabricado en metal duradero.
Safe closure cap: Avoid spills and facilitate use.
Official design Real Madrid: With club shield and adidas logo.
Easy transport: Includes handle for convenience.

source.subtitle: Botellín de agua adidas del Real Madrid de 600 ml - blanco
